island.name: Restaurant & café
island.description: Ordering food and drinks, asking about the menu, complaining politely and paying.

sentences.en: A table for two, please.
sentences.ro: O masă pentru două persoane, vă rog.
sentences.note: Staff are addressed with "vă rog" (formal) even if you use "tu" elsewhere.

sentences.en: Can I see the menu, please?
sentences.ro: Pot să văd meniul, vă rog?

sentences.en: I'd like a coffee with milk, please.
sentences.ro: Aș vrea o cafea cu lapte, vă rog.
sentences.note: "Aș vrea" is the polite default for ordering — softer than "vreau".

sentences.en: What do you recommend today?
Is this dish spicy?
I don't eat meat, do you have something vegetarian?
sentences.ro: Nu mănânc carne, aveți ceva vegetarian?

sentences.en: I'll have the soup and a glass of water.
sentences.ro: Iau supa și un pahar cu apă.
sentences.note: "Un pahar cu apă" (a glass with water) is what people actually say.

sentences.en: Still water, not sparkling.
How long do I have to wait?
This isn't what I ordered.
The food is really good, thank you.
Could you bring me some bread, please?
sentences.ro: Îmi puteți aduce niște pâine, vă rog?

sentences.en: I'm allergic to nuts.
The coffee is cold, can you change it?
sentences.ro: Cafeaua e rece, o puteți schimba?

sentences.en: Can I have this to go?
sentences.ro: Pot să iau asta la pachet?
sentences.note: "La pachet" is the fixed phrase for takeaway.

sentences.en: The bill, please.
sentences.note: "Nota" (de plată) — not "factura", which means an invoice.

sentences.en: Can I pay by card?
We're paying separately.
Keep the change.
I'm not hungry, just a tea for me.
sentences.ro: Nu mi-e foame, doar un ceai pentru mine.
sentences.note: Hunger uses "a fi" with a dative pronoun: "mi-e foame" = I am hungry.
